Automatic defrost When the outdoor temperature is low and the humidity is high, frost may develop on the outdoor heat exchanger, which may decrease heating efficiency. When these conditions are met while Heat mode is on, the Mini-Split runs the Defrost function for 5 to 12 minutes to remove frost from the outdoor heat exchanger. NOTE • When the Defrost function is on, the (Defrost) indicator appears on the indoor unit display, steam is produced on the outdoor unit, and the airflow blades do not move. After the defrost operation is complete, the blades return to the angle set by the user.) • You cannot select other functions with the remote control until the Defrost function is finished.
